import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
df4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
df5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/training_5.csv", index_col=0)
df6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/training_6.csv", index_col=0)
df7 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/training_7.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION all source tables (concatenate)
df = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3, df4, df5, df6, df7], ignore_index=True)

# GROUP BY created and screenname, aggregate followers, favourites, and text by max
df_grouped = df.groupby(['created', 'screenname'], as_index=False).agg({
    'followers': 'max',
    'favourites': 'max',
    'text': 'max'
})

# Write the final output with exact target schema and column order
df_grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
